verdict.rationale: uv supports per-directory Python version pinning: `uv python pin` writes `.python-version`, and uv respects the project's pinned version. `uv run` also handles the project venv and Python install automatically when commands run inside a project. This only takes effect when uv commands are invoked, not when you enter the directory, and nothing covers environment variables. Missing for 10: automatic activation on directory entry (shell hook), per-project environment-variable loading, version management for non-Python tools, independent corroboration of directory-scoped activation.
